svg.text: Paladin bond example — who sees what, transaction by transaction

Each row is one Paladin transaction from examples/bond/src/index.ts. Each node column shows what that node holds for it: the transaction itself, the indexed receipt, and the private states (spent / read / confirmed / info).

Noto shares a state only with the notary, the sender, and the owners of the coins involved. Pente shares with the members of the privacy group. A public transaction is tracked only by the node that submitted it.
notary of the bond token · member of both groups

ordinary public tx; only the submitter's Paladin tracks it

Captured from a live three-node run on 2026-10-22 by querying ptx_getTransactionFull, ptx_getTransactionReceiptFull and ptx_getStateReceipt on each node. TX23 and TX24 are the Noto receipts Paladin indexes from the events emitted by the Atom.execute() call in TX22; they have no submitting node.
